t.zh: 倒着用假设框，目标少一层「若」，却没有证完：<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>只会把目标换成前提。
t.en: The box used backwards takes one “if” off a goal, but does not finish it: <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref> only replaces a goal with premises.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref>：把第一个目标和它的一条已知合一，对上了，这个目标就证完了。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref>: it unifies the first goal with one of its givens; when one fits, that goal is done.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 剥掉所有的「若」之后，剩下的目标在哪里？
hint.en: With every “if” peeled off, where is the goal that is left?
